output.narrative_summary: This result rests on the link from Engineering Capacity to Total Cost of Ownership. If capacity assumptions change, more runs could support a different option. In this model, 58% of runs supported Rebuild In House.

story_headlines.opt_rebuild: Rebuild In House reflects lower modelled cost of ownership when engineering capacity holds up as assumed.
story_headlines.opt_extend: Extend Vendor Contract would gain support if engineering capacity proves more constrained than currently assumed.

robustness_explanation.summary: The ordering holds in about 61% of variations, based on current estimates.
robustness_explanation.primary_risk: The link from Engineering Capacity to Total Cost of Ownership is not firmly evidenced and could shift the comparison.
fragility_factors: The link from Engineering Capacity to Total Cost of Ownership could flip which option more runs support.

output.readiness_rationale: Two gaps still hold this back: Engineering Capacity is asserted rather than evidenced, and Vendor Price Path carries moderate confidence, so the comparison is not yet settled enough to act on.

fac_eng_capacity.specific_action: Run a capacity audit against current engineering roadmap commitments to establish actual available headcount for a rebuild.
fac_eng_capacity.rationale: This factor is asserted rather than evidenced, and the comparison is sensitive to it.
fac_eng_capacity.decision_hygiene: Estimate the answer before looking at the audit data.

fac_vendor_price.specific_action: Request the vendor's multi-year price schedule and any contractual escalation clauses in writing.
fac_vendor_price.rationale: Vendor Price Path carries only moderate confidence and feeds the cost outcome directly.
fac_vendor_price.decision_hygiene: Compare the quoted schedule against your own extrapolation before reacting to it.

bias_findings.description: The comparison leans on an engineering capacity assumption that is asserted rather than evidenced. Is that assumption as solid as the model treats it?

The link from Vendor Price Path to Total Cost of Ownership assumes the vendor's pricing trend continues as currently modelled.
